author: Shoto_
body:
I had an empty void world. So I hopped on, after looking at the Butterfly Nebula, and just started building.
http://imgur.com/sVvTbZP
This is all I have so far, and I admit it's ugly and small, but since I am continuing to build it, I think it'll look pretty.
http://www.wolaver.org/space/NGC6302.jpg
Click the ↑↑↑ to see what I am basing it off of. :3

replies.author: goldenwalrus909
replies.body:
Yes, you should definitely get it. It helps tons with making symmetrical maps like this. Since it's 4-way symmetry, you only have to build 25% of it and just copy and paste the other 25% to make one side, then take that 50% and copy and paste it to make the other side. This map looks like it has a lot of potential, and I wish you good luck! :D
If you have any trouble getting SPC (Single player commands (World-edit)), just ask me!
